description: Customer SMS templates (E.7, D-25, D-43). GSM-7 only and one 160-septet segment at the worst-case lengths asserted by SmsCatalogueTest (a 17-character amount, a 16-character E.164 number and a verification link of at most SmsCatalogue.MAX_LINK_LENGTH characters). No template asks for a PIN or password. status is machine_draft until a native speaker reviews the text and it is marked reviewed (D-43); none has been reviewed.
